webserver_enabled.description: Enable the Puppet Server HTTP web interface (required for admin tools and status endpoints)

webserver_cert_hostname.description: Hostname used in SSL certificates for the web server (overrides cert-hostname in auth.conf); leave empty to use `puppet_server_hostname`

puppet_server_hostname.description: Primary hostname for this Puppet Server (used as fallback for cert-hostname and CA name)

ca_enabled.description: Enable the Certificate Authority (CA) service; disable only for ca-bundle-only or proxy deployments

ca_name.description: Human-readable CA identifier (e.g., 'Puppet CA: prod-puppet-01'); leave empty for auto-generated

ca_max_serial_numbers.description: Maximum number of certificates to track in memory (increase for large infrastructures)

api_v1_services_enabled.description: Route agent service requests through the v1 API (legacy); leave disabled for Puppet v7+

auth_rules.description: Additional authorization rules (beyond default puppetlabs services access)

method.description: HTTP method(s); comma-separated list allowed (e.g., 'GET, POST')

sort_order.description: Optional sort priority; lower numbers evaluated first

jvm_java_home.description: Path to Java 11+ runtime (JRE or JDK); Puppet Server requires Java 11–17
